verdict.rationale: telli documents workflows that run automatically on a recurring schedule through a Scheduled trigger, with no call event needed. Workflows can also send SMS and WhatsApp actions, which together amount to autonomous background automation. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on scheduled workflow configuration and limits (the evidence is changelog-level only), independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of monitoring or failure handling for background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows can now run automatically on a recurring schedule. Add a Scheduled trigger, choose the interval and start time, and let the workflow run without a call event.
Choose SMS and WhatsApp workflow recipients from contact properties, collected values, or a fixed number
Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
